text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"opening hook and clear position","quality":"engaging introduction","description":"It begins with a conversational lead-in and quickly signals a stance, which gives the essay a more developed argumentative opening."},{"evidence":"three-paragraph structure with intro, body, conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It is organized into distinct sections that make the line of argument easier to follow from start to finish."},{"evidence":"“However, some people might argue…”","quality":"counterargument","description":"It acknowledges an opposing view and responds to it, which makes the argument feel more balanced and deliberate."},{"evidence":"“sensor that have been developed many years ago are being used… each time these sensors are being put to use, they get refined”","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"It explains how the article’s technology details support its point instead of only stating a claim."},{"evidence":"“For example… safer passage routes through airplanes”","quality":"use of illustrative examples","description":"It adds supporting examples beyond the article to clarify the argument and make the ideas more concrete."},{"evidence":"“driverless cars are not completely driverless right now”","quality":"qualification","description":"It shows some nuance by limiting the claim and recognizing uncertainty rather than speaking in absolute terms."}]}
